subject.title: Skill steipete/bird: Homebrew formula download URL 404 (bird-macos-universal-v0.8.0.tar.gz)

question: Should the old `steipete/bird` ClawHub listing remain unavailable, be republished with a valid upstream, be marked deprecated, or be aliased to Birdclaw?
rationale: Current main has no Bird payload to edit, live ClawHub no longer serves the broken API record, and Birdclaw is only a plausible replacement until the namespace owner or ClawHub admin confirms old-slug intent.

options.title: Owner/admin metadata decision
options.body: Verify upstream intent, then update production metadata, hide/deprecate the old slug, or add an alias only if Birdclaw is confirmed equivalent.

options.title: Keep old slug unavailable
options.body: If Bird was intentionally removed, preserve the current public API 404 behavior and record that decision before closing.

options.title: Build unavailable-skill UX
options.body: If removed skills should stay visible, add a source-backed hidden/deprecated page flow instead of changing this listing ad hoc.

recommendation.title: Owner/admin metadata decision
recommendation.body: Verify upstream intent, then update production metadata, hide/deprecate the old slug, or add an alias only if Birdclaw is confirmed equivalent.

likelyOwner.reason: The disputed namespace and replacement candidate are under `steipete`, so this is the clearest routing point for the metadata decision.
